description: This is an Android Fragment source file implementing the main home screen of an Android TV app. It sets up a vertically scrollable layout with sections including a hero banner, a top navigation bar integrated via Jetpack Compose, and sections for 'Continue Watching' and 'TV Channels' with loading states and focus management for D-pad navigation.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A Fragment representing the main home screen, managing UI layout including hero banner, top navigation, and content rails, with focus and focus navigation management for Android TV.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the ContentRepository (using a FakeContentRepository) and creates the ViewModel.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Sets up the root view hierarchy, including scroll views, containers, and content sections, and adds the Jetpack Compose TopNavBar.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Begins observing ViewModel states, requests initial focus, and triggers data loading.

methods.name: observeViewModelStates
methods.description: Subscribes to ViewModel LiveData for continue watching and TV channels, updating UI accordingly.

methods.name: showContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Displays the loading indicator for the Continue Watching section.

methods.name: hideContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Hides the loading indicator for the Continue Watching section.

methods.name: showTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Displays the loading indicator for the TV Channels section.

methods.name: hideTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Hides the loading indicator for the TV Channels section.

methods.name: showErrorWithRetry
methods.description: Shows an error message with a prompt to retry loading data.

methods.name: updateContinueWatchingRail
methods.description: Populates the continue watching horizontal list with data.

methods.name: updateTvChannelsRail
methods.description: Populates the TV channels horizontal list with data.

methods.name: addComposeTopNavBar
methods.description: Adds a Jetpack Compose TopNavBar, positioned 18dp from top, centered horizontally, with initial focus on search icon.

methods.name: setupHeroBanner
methods.description: Creates and adds the hero banner section.

methods.name: setupContinueWatchingSection
methods.description: Creates and adds the 'Seguí viendo' section with loading indicator and scroll list.

methods.name: setupTvChannelsSection
methods.description: Creates and adds the 'Canales de TV' section with loading indicator and scroll list.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels (dp) to actual pixels for layout dimensioning.
